scope_summary: One existing billing-enabled project; verifies bootstrap prerequisites, enables the fixed gcp.phase8-api-baseline.v1 superset, and creates a prefixed deployment service account, custom role binding, and one user-managed key.

permission_groups.scope: Generated twin2mc-* service account in the selected project
Selected project custom role and project IAM policy

credential_cleanup: Delete only the submitted service-account key after its private material is cryptographically matched to the exact provider key ID through the returned X.509 public key.

Fail closed when the generated service account contains a user-managed key that is not the sole key recorded by the current rollback receipt; never replace or delete that unrecorded key automatically.
Remove the exact project binding before deleting the gate-owned service account and custom role.
Treat a gate-owned custom role with deleted=true as successfully deactivated during Google's seven-day soft-delete window; do not reuse its run ID.
Never delete or alter an existing_user_owned service-account key.
Keep the shared Phase 8 API baseline enabled after bootstrap cleanup.
Return manual_revocation_required when key creation policy or delete authority prevents safe cleanup.
limitations: The live v3 path is restricted to an existing project; organization/project-creation mode remains fail-closed pending a separate reviewed contract.
The Service Usage, IAM, and Cloud Resource Manager APIs must already be available before bootstrap starts.
Organization policy can forbid user-managed service-account key creation; the bootstrap must fail closed and must not weaken that policy.
API enablement creates no Twin workload but can create Google-managed service agents; enabled APIs are retained after credential cleanup.
The permission names and scope bindings require a separately approved query-testable-permissions and live validation.
